title: No Surface Lava
description: Prevents lakes of lava from generating in your world
body:
## About

I created this as these lava lakes have annoyed me for so long, and has destroyed so much beautiful nature in my worlds. And the lava setting fire to a forest for instance, can cause lag and stutters, especially if hosting a world for multiple people. So if you're tired of the same thing happening in your worlds, then finally there is a fix!

![Illustration](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/wpuEjeop/images/a9662d26737249d6dd138b28260bf2403a04fe1e.jpeg)

## Functionality

This is a mod/datapack that will disable lava lakes from generating in your world. This also includes lava flooding out the side of mountains.

It does not prevent the generation of lava lakes underground, and doesn't prevent lava generation in relation to broken portals.

With v1.1, you can get it as either a mod or datapack. Both options are a single file, supporting 1.21.x - 26.2.

_Note: The datapack shows an error when loading it into mc version 26.x. This is simply a visual error message, and it doesn't mean anything for the functionality of the datapack._
